sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: The 📊 unique-values dropdown's outside-click handler closed the panel and immediately reopened it when the click landed on the count badge (`.mb-col-uniq-count`) instead of the glyph (`.mb-col-uniq-btn`) — the glyph's own `pointer-events: none` made a click there resolve to the wrapper element, which the handler recognized, while the count badge (which must keep `pointer-events` for its tooltip) does not. A second click on the counter now closes the dropdown, matching the glyph.
